## Ecosystem & Platforms
1. **MJ Digital Agency**: Full-service web development, headless CMS integrations, and digital marketing agency (https://maajankiwebtech.com).
2. **BrewPluse POS**: Modern cloud Cafe & Restaurant Management Software (https://brewpluse.com).
3. **MJ Pro Next.js Starter Kit**: Production-ready Next.js 16 + Tailwind CSS + WooCommerce Headless commerce framework.

## Technical Core Competencies
- Frameworks: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Headless Architecture: Headless WordPress REST APIs, GraphQL, WooCommerce Store API
- Commerce & Payments: Razorpay payment gateway integration, instant UPI QR generation, automated webhook fulfillment
- SEO & Machine Retrieval: Structured data (JSON-LD Organization, Product, Article, FAQPage), Core Web Vitals optimization, llms.txt standard compliance
